text: dsh-paper-design 是连接 Paper Desktop 与 DSH 的设计插件。它通过本机 MCP 服务发现 Paper 工具并注册为 DSH 的 paper_* 工具，同时把截图转成附件图像供模型查看。插件还会向系统提示注入设计指引，注册 code-to-design、design-to-code 和 paper-design 技能，并提供重新连接及 OAuth 状态、登录和退出命令。适合希望让 DSH 读取、创建或编辑 Paper 画布设计，并将画面截图交给图像模型检查的用户。需要运行 Paper Desktop 并打开文件；截图图像支持还需要附件服务和图像模型路由。

dsh-paper-design connects DSH to Paper Desktop over local MCP and exposes Paper tools as paper_* tools. It forwards screenshots as attachments, adds design guidance and skills, and offers reconnect and OAuth commands. Use it to inspect or edit Paper canvases with DSH; Paper Desktop must be open.

dsh-paper-design 的功能「调用 Paper 工具」：连接 Paper Desktop MCP，并把发现的工具注册为 DSH 的 paper_* 工具，供 agent 读取或编辑画布。
dsh-paper-design 的功能「转发截图」：调用返回图像内容的 Paper 工具时，插件解码图像并保存为 DSH 附件，再把附件图像块交给模型上下文。需要附件服务接受对应图像格式。
dsh-paper-design 的功能「连接恢复」：启动时无法连接 Paper Desktop 时按配置间隔后台重试，连接成功后发布工具；也可运行 /paper-reconnect 手动重连并刷新指引缓存。
dsh-paper-design 的功能「设计指引和技能」：持续注入设计规则，并在连接后的早期轮次加入完整指南；注册 code-to-design、design-to-code 和 paper-design 技能供 agent 使用。
dsh-paper-design 的功能「OAuth 管理」：服务启用认证时，可用状态、登录和退出命令管理 MCP OAuth 会话。
dsh-paper-design 使用前须知：需运行 Paper Desktop 并打开文件；OAuth 令牌存于 DSH 数据目录下的 paper-design/oauth.json。

@try-works/dsh-paper-design README · dsh-paper-design：Paper Design MCP bridge as a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) bundle.

Connects to the **Paper Desktop** MCP server (`http://127.0.0.1:29979/mcp`), registers every Paper tool as a native `paper_*` tool with image screenshot support, injects Cursor-parity design guidance, registers the Paper skills, and exposes reconnect + OAuth auth commands.

@try-works/dsh-paper-design README · What it provides：- **`paper_*` tools** — every tool advertised by Paper Desktop MCP (`get_basic_info`, `get_screenshot`, `write_html`, `update_styles`, …), registered natively on `ctx.tools`. Raw MCP `inputSchema`s are normalized to the enforced DSH JSON-Schema subset (`$schema`/`format`/`pattern`/`propertyNames`/`min*`/`max*` stripped, `anyOf`→`oneOf`).
- **Image screenshot forwarding** — `get_screenshot` image blocks are decoded and durably committed through `ctx.attachments` (`saveImage`), then emitted as attachment-backed image blocks (and deferred as plugin-sourced context for nested `run_code` dispatches), so screenshots reach image-capable models.
- **Cursor-parity guidance** — standing rules injected as a system-prompt section (order 150), plus the full `paper-mcp-instructions` guide injected for the first 2 agent turns after connect/reconnect. `paper_get_guide` also caches the guide body.
- **Skills** — `code-to-design`, `design-to-code` (Cursor Paper plugin bodies verbatim), and `paper-design` (progressive-disclosure tool reference index).
- **`/paper-reconnect`** — re-initializes the MCP session, **(re)registers the `paper_*` tools**,

@try-works/dsh-paper-design README · Requirements：- **Paper Desktop** running with a file open (the MCP server lives inside the desktop app). It does not have to be running when DSH boots — the bridge picks it up when it appears.
- **DSH** `0.2.0-rc.2` or `0.1.0-rc.5`+ — the plugin declares matching `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer ranges, and DSH refuses to load it on a runtime outside them.
- A DeepSeek Harness profile that bundles `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` (or the services it mounts): `tools`, `systemPrompt`, `attachments` (for images), `skills`, `commands`, `llm`.
- An image-capable model route for screenshot support (text tools work on any route).

@try-works/dsh-paper-design README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build                        # type-check (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json)
pnpm run verify                       # live MCP bridge verification (needs Paper Desktop)
pnpm run verify:bridge                # in-process plugin boot + live paper_get_basic_info

@try-works/dsh-paper-design README · Layout：- `src/index.ts` — bundle entry: register prompt/skills/commands, then connect, normalize, and (re)register tools with late-start retry.
- `src/mcp-client.ts` — minimal Streamable HTTP MCP client (initialize/tools-list/tools-call, session tracking, SSE parsing, one-shot re-init, bearer-token + challenge hooks).
- `src/auth.ts` — discovery-driven MCP OAuth 2.1 client (RFC 8414/OIDC discovery, DCR, PKCE, loopback redirect, token exchange/refresh, persisted store, challenge handling).
- `src/schema.ts` — raw Paper JSON Schema → enforced DSH subset normalizer.
- `src/guide.ts` — standing rules + early-turn guide markers and builder.
- `src/skills.ts` — runtime skill registrations.
- `skills/*/SKILL.md` — on-disk skill bodies (parity artifacts).
- `cordis.patch.yml` — loader patch inserting the bridge into a `cordis:group` realm.
